# ZenPen (Zen Pen Enterprise)

> ZenPen is a Ghanaian-owned, online-first retail business. Tagline: "Shop calm.
> Live bold." It sells genuine mobile electronics and accessories, fashion and
> apparel, and beauty and personal care products to customers across Ghana,
> mainly through WhatsApp, social media and its website. Launching soon.

## Categories

- Mobile Electronics & Accessories: smartphones, tablets, earbuds, headphones,
  power banks, chargers, smartwatches, Bluetooth speakers, cases and cables.
- Fashion & Apparel: men's and women's clothing, African-print and made-in-Ghana
  pieces, footwear, bags, watches, sunglasses and jewellery.
- Beauty & Personal Care: skincare, shea butter and black soap, haircare, wigs,
  make-up, perfumes and men's grooming.

## Ordering

- Email: zenpengh@gmail.com
- Website: https://zenpengh.com
- Payment: Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo Money) and bank
  transfer. Card payments coming soon.
- Status: launching soon. Delivery options and fees will be announced at launch.
- Bulk, corporate and gift orders accepted; wholesale for resellers planned.
